# Authorized Gas Tester (AGT) Training

> 8-hour online course for Authorized Gas Testers on identifying, monitoring and controlling hazardous atmospheres before and during high-risk work (confined spaces, hot work, H2S). Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Regulatory alignment: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.146, 1910.119, 1910.120, 1910.147, 1910.252, 1910.106, 1910.1000, 1910.134, 1910 Subpart Z, and OSH Act General Duty Clause Section 5(a)(1)
- Duration: about 8 hours; 7 modules, 19 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.8 CEU
- Price: $339.99 per person online; bulk pricing from 2 seats
- Other formats: SCORM, virtual instructor-led, in-person
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, any device; English and Spanish
- Completion window: 3 months; 1 year of access to materials
- Certificate: instant PDF on passing, valid 12 months
- Teaching approach: incident case studies (confined space fatalities, hot work ignitions, H2S releases); reading trends, stratification and cross-sensitivities; permit-to-work and LOTO integration

## Who it is for
Confined space entrants; hot work crews; handlers of flammable, toxic or reactive substances; safety officers and supervisors; industrial and chemical maintenance teams; emergency responders; contractors performing gas testing; anyone in an AGT role.

## Modules
1. Authorized Gas Tester Fundamentals
2. Operations Requiring Gas Testing
3. Risk Assessment Requirements
4. Respiratory Protection and PPE
5. Understanding Gas Detection Equipment (4-gas meter checks, calibration)
6. Gas Testing for High-Risk Operations (hot work, confined space, H2S)
7. Emergency Response and Abnormal Situations
